name: Espresso
description: A strong, concentrated coffee brewed by forcing hot water through finely-ground coffee beans.

name: Americano
description: Espresso diluted with hot water, resulting in a smoother and milder flavor.

name: Latte
description: A coffee drink made with espresso and steamed milk, often topped with a small amount of foam.

name: Cappuccino
description: Similar to a latte but with equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and milk foam, giving it a creamier texture.

name: Macchiato
description: An espresso with a small amount of milk or milk foam, offering a stronger coffee flavor.

name: Mocha
description: A chocolate-flavored coffee drink made with espresso, steamed milk, and chocolate syrup or cocoa powder.

name: Flat White
description: A velvety smooth coffee made with espresso and steamed milk, with a thinner layer of foam compared to a latte.

name: Turkish Coffee
description: A strong, unfiltered coffee made by boiling very finely ground coffee beans in water, often with sugar and cardamom.

name: Cold Brew
description: Coffee brewed with cold water over an extended period (12–24 hours), resulting in a smooth and less acidic taste.

name: Irish Coffee
description: A cocktail combining hot coffee, Irish whiskey, sugar, and a layer of cream on top.
